_comment: Per-client catch baselines for `make ingest-calibrate` / `make ingest-calibrate-live` (Docs/ingestion/rebuild-spec.md §4). A class below its baseline catch rate, or above its recorded false_refusals/dropped, fails the target; null = pending detector; `_runs` records when and with which models each block was measured. `mock` is what the scripted harness run produces; `live` is written by the owner with --update-baseline after an accepted live run.
